# You-AI-You

> You-AI-You is a free AI skill by Ricky Soo for Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. It makes the AI work in three steps: you give the facts first, the AI drafts using only your facts, and you check and approve last. Free to use and share with credit (CC BY 4.0).

## Get it
- [Download the skill (you-ai-you.zip)](https://rickysoo.github.io/you-ai-you/you-ai-you.zip): upload to Claude (Customize > Skills > + > Upload a skill), ChatGPT (Skills > Create > Upload from your computer) or Gemini (Skills > Create > Upload).
- [Full instructions as plain text](https://rickysoo.github.io/you-ai-you/you-ai-you.txt): for AI tools without skills; paste into custom instructions or the start of a chat.
